description:
Create a professional map layout of the world countries and export it as an image.

gvSIG Desktop is already open with the 'countries_base' project loaded. This project contains a View named 'Vista' with the Natural Earth countries layer.

Your task is to create a printable map composition:

1. Go to the Project Manager (Window > Show Project Manager) and select 'Map'.
2. Create a New Map document.
3. In the Map layout editor, insert the following elements:
   - A **View Frame** displaying the 'Vista' view (View > Insert view).
   - A **Title** text element reading exactly: "World Countries Map".
   - A **Legend** linked to the view frame.
   - A **Scale Bar** linked to the view frame.
   - A **North Arrow**.

4. Arrange these elements so they form a clean map layout.
5. Export the map layout as a PNG image to: `/home/ga/gvsig_data/exports/world_map_layout.png`
   (File > Export to... > Image, or similar menu option depending on the interface).

The task is complete when the PNG file exists and contains all the required cartographic elements.
